시편-63-1.title: 시편 63장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-63-1.exegesis: 12. for thou renderest-- literally, "that Thou renderest," &c., connected with "I heard this," as the phrase--"that power," &c. [Psa 62:11]--teaching that by His power He can show both mercy and justice.

시편-63-2.title: 시편 63장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-63-2.exegesis: PSALM 63 Psa 63:1-11 . The historical occasion referred to by the title was probably during Absalom's rebellion (compare 2Sa 15:23 , 28 ; 16:2 ). David expresses an earnest desire for God's favor, and a confident expectation of realizing it in his deliverance and the ruin of his enemies. 1. early ... seek thee-- earnestly ( Is 26:9 ). The figurative terms-- dry and thirsty-- literally, "weary," denoting moral destitution, suited his outward circumstances. soul-- and--flesh--the whole man ( Psa 16:9 , 10 ).

시편-63-3.title: 시편 63장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-63-3.exegesis: 2. The special object of desire was God's perfections as displayed in his worship ( Psa 27:4 ).
시편-63-3.theologicalNote: 2. The special object of desire was God's perfections as displayed in his worship ( Psa 27:4 ).

시편-63-4.title: 시편 63장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-63-4.exegesis: 3. Experiencing God's mercy, which exceeds all the blessings of life, his lips will be opened for his praise ( Psa 51:15 ).
시편-63-4.theologicalNote: 3. Experiencing God's mercy, which exceeds all the blessings of life, his lips will be opened for his praise ( Psa 51:15 ).

시편-63-5.title: 시편 63장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-63-5.exegesis: 4. Thus-- literally, "Truly." will I bless-- praise Thee ( Psa 34:1 ). lift up my hands-- in worship (compare Psa 28:2 ). in thy name-- in praise of Thy perfections.
시편-63-5.theologicalNote: 4. Thus-- literally, "Truly." will I bless-- praise Thee ( Psa 34:1 ). lift up my hands-- in worship (compare Psa 28:2 ). in thy name-- in praise of Thy perfections.

시편-63-6.exegesis: 5-8. Full spiritual blessings satisfy his desires, and acts of praise fill his thoughts and time.
